mapper.sql: id, goods_id, mnemonic_code, org_goods_bar, org_goods_name, org_sort, org_goods_type, goods_tag, selling_point, life_cycle_id, goods_status_id, sort_id, org_code, biz_org_code, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select gogi.id, gogi.goods_id, gogi.mnemonic_code, gogi.org_goods_bar, gogi.org_goods_name, gogi.org_sort, gogi.org_goods_type, gogi.goods_tag, gogi.selling_point, gogi.life_cycle_id, gogi.goods_status_id, gogi.sort_id, gogi.org_code, gogi.biz_org_code, gogi.creator, gogi.create_time, gogi.updater, gogi.update_time, gogi.is_delete from gc_org_goods_info gogi INNER JOIN gc_standard_goods_info gsgi on gogi.goods_id = gsgi.id and gsgi.is_delete = 0 where gogi.is_delete = 0 and gsgi.goods_code = #{goodsCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select CASE WHEN gogd.storage_area = 'highWorth' THEN 3 WHEN gogd.storage_area = 'wholeUnit' THEN 2 WHEN gogd.storage_area = 'bulk' THEN 1 ELSE 4 END AS statistical_type FROM gc_standard_goods_info gsgi INNER JOIN gc_org_goods_info gogi ON gsgi.id = gogi.goods_id AND gogi.is_delete = 0 AND gogi.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} INNER JOIN gc_org_goods_distribution gogd ON gogi.id = gogd.org_goods_id AND gogd.is_delete = 0 WHERE gsgi.goods_code = #{goodsCode} AND gsgi.is_delete = 0

select ifnull(gpgg.sell_price, 0) from gc_price_group_goods gpgg inner join sc_store_goods_config ssgc on gpgg.price_group_code = ssgc.selling_price_code and ssgc.is_delete = 0 where ssgc.store_code = #{storeCode} and ssgc.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and gpgg.bar_code = #{goodsCode} and gpgg.is_delete = 0 and gpgg.specification_number = 1 limit 1
